Welcome to Teastas Eorpach na Gaeilge 
#  Welcome
Teastas Eorpach na Gaeilge (TEG) provides a series of general Irish language proficiency examinations and qualifications for adult learners of Irish. TEG exams give candidates an opportunity to show their ability in speaking, listening, reading and writing Irish at different levels, from absolute beginner to intermediate and advanced levels.
Exams are offered at five levels at present and are taken each year by candidates with various levels of fluency. These have included:
  * adult learners taking part in a Dublin evening course, returning to the study of Irish for the first time since 1970; 
  * Irish language tutors at an Irish university;
  * County council staff from Kerry, Galway, Tipperary and Clare, to name but a few;
  * Irish-language journalists;
  * teachers of Irish at primary and secondary school level;
  * students at a Canadian university learning Irish for the first time.

Candidates also have the option of taking the oral exam only, with a view to gaining specific certification in the spoken language.
Exams take place in April and May each year in ten centres in Ireland and in four centres abroad. Several hundred learners take TEG exams each year. TEG syllabuses and exams provide both teachers and learners with clear learning objectives and a structured step-by-step path to fluency in Irish.
As well as being the preferred method for learners to make progress in the language, a number of organizations now use TEG exams in recruitment and selection procedures as a means of ensuring that potential employees/students have the required language skills.
These exams are broadly based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (Council of Europe, 2001).
This site has been developed to deliver information on all aspects of TEG examinations to learners at all levels, teachers of Irish to adults, secondary school teachers, employers and Irish language organizations. We hope you find all the information you need here.
## What level of Irish do I have?

## TEG exams
Click on the links below to find all of the material you will need at each level: Syllabuses, Sample Exam Papers, Examiner Reports and Sample Teaching Materials. 
  * [Bonnleibhéal 1**(A1)**](https://www.teg.ie/l%C3%A9ibheil-scr%C3%BAduithe/bonnleibh%C3%A9al-1-a1.252.html)
  * [Bonnleibhéal 2**(A2)**](https://www.teg.ie/l%C3%A9ibheil-scr%C3%BAduithe/bonnleibh%C3%A9al-2-a2.253.html)
  * [Meánleibhéal 1**(B1)**](https://www.teg.ie/l%C3%A9ibheil-scr%C3%BAduithe/me%C3%A1nleibh%C3%A9al-1-b1.254.html)
  * [Meánleibhéal 2**(B2)**](https://www.teg.ie/l%C3%A9ibheil-scr%C3%BAduithe/me%C3%A1nleibh%C3%A9al-2-b2.255.html)
  * [Ardleibhéal 1**(C1)**](https://www.teg.ie/l%C3%A9ibheil-scr%C3%BAduithe/ardleibh%C3%A9al-1-c1.256.html)

[FAQs](https://www.teg.ie/faqs.150.html)
## [Latest News](https://www.teg.ie/blog.9.html)
Exams will be run at levels A1, A2, B1 & B2 in May/June 2026. 
Applications are now open for B1 exam for applicants to the B.Ed through Irish in Marino. You will find more information here. 
TEG is currently seeking to recruit a Digital Transformation Officer to coordinate technological developments as part of the TEG testing system. The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing new technological developments, including a new website, a new registration and data/communications management system, a platform for digital testing and digital certification. A minimum of B2-level Irish will be required. Further details are available here. 

  * [More Blogs](https://www.teg.ie/news.9.html)

[All news](https://www.teg.ie/news.9.html)
# Resources
  * [Exam Material](https://www.teg.ie/about-exams/exam-levels.142.html)
  * [Courses, Grammar books, Dictionaries](https://www.teg.ie/_fileupload/resources.pdf)
  * [Find a TEG-based course](https://www.teg.ie/info-advice/course-centres.989.html)
  * [Online Test](http://secure.teg.ie/quiz/)

# Teaching Materials 
[Teachers, here you will find sample teaching materials, based on each TEG syllabus from Bonnleibhéal 1 (A1) to Meánleibhéal 2 (B2).](https://www.teg.ie/links-resources/teaching-materials.290.html)
# TEG in secondary schools
TEG examinations are taken each year by secondary school students in schools around the country. [Click for further information.](https://www.teg.ie/info-advice/information-for-secondary-schools.261.html)
## TEG Exam Applications 
Application / payment [forms are here](http://www.teg.ie/about-exams/register-and-pay-online.162.html). Select the form that matches your profile. 
TEG oral exams can be organised for groups at any time of the year. Email [teg@mu.ie](http://teanga@nuim.ie) for further information. 
Information regarding TEG exams in secondary schools can be found [here](https://www.teg.ie/info-advice/information-for-secondary-schools.261.html).

## Cúrsaí Cuimsitheacha (Complete Courses)
Teideal: Turas Teanga Úda(i)r: Ó Dónaill, Éamonn Cur síos: Is cúrsa ilmheán é Turas Teanga atá dírithe ar fhoghlaimeoirí Gaeilge ag an mheánleibhéal. Bhí sraith teilifíse i gceist ina raibh 20 páirt agus craoladh é seo ar RTÉ sa chéad chuid de 2004. Tá na cláracha sin le fáil anois ar DVD agus tá na gnéithe seo a leanas sa chúrsa chomh maith: leabhar (arna fhoilsiú ag Gill and Macmillan), trí dhlúthdhiosca, suíomh gréasáin (www.rte.ie/tv/turasteanga). Foilsitheoir: RTÉ/ Gill and Macmillan Teideal: Gaeilge agus Fáilte Úda(i)r: Byrne, Annette Cur síos: Cúrsa atá dírithe orthu siúd nach bhfuil aon Ghaeilge acu. Tá leabhar 200 leathanach agus dhá chaiséad fuaime 60 nóiméad i gceist sa chúrsa seo. Description: Aimed at those with no Irish. A 200-page book and two 60-minute cassettes. Foilsitheoir: ITÉ/Gael-Linn (2001)
* * *
Teideal: Now You're Talking Úda(i)r: Ó Dónaill, Éamonn & Ní Churraighín, Deirbhile Cur síos: Is cúrsa nua-aimseartha ilmheán é 'Now You're Talking' atá dírithe orthu siúd nach bhfuil aon Ghaeilge acu agus orthu siúd a bhfuil buneolas acu ar an teanga. Tá sé bunaithe ar an tsraith teilifíse den ainm céanna a taispeánadh ar RTÉ agus ar an BBC roinnt blianta ó shin. Chomh maith le leabhar ildaite, tá cúig chaiséad sa chúrsa seo agus is féidir fístéipeanna a cheannach freisin ón Iontaobhas Ultach i mBéal Feirste. Description: Modern multi-media course aimed at those with no basic Irish or no Irish at all. Based on the eponymous TV series. Apart from a full-colour book there are 5 audio cassettes and it is possible to buy video cassettes from the Iontaobhas Ultach in Belfast. Foilsitheoir: Gael Media (1995) Teideal: Speaking Irish – An Ghaeilge Bheo Úda(i)r: Ní Mhaonaigh, Siuán & Mac Lochlainn, Antain Cur síos: Pacáiste foghlama d'fhoghlaimeoirí atá ag an mheánleibhéal nó ag an ardleibhéal. Tá DVD ann ar a bhfuil os cionn 45 agallamh ar fad a chlúdaíonn fiche téama ar leith. Tá leabhar leis an DVD ina bhfuil téacs na n-agallamh go léir, chomh maith le nótaí foclóra, foghraíochta agus cultúrtha agus treoir faoi phointí gramadaí a mbíonn deacrachtaí ag foghlaimeoirí leo. Is féidir le múinteoirí leas a bhaint as na bileoga saothair don seomra ranga atá le fáil le híoslódáil saor in aisce ó www.mhprofessional.com. Foilsitheoir: McGraw Hill (2008)
* * *
## Teideal: Cúrsa Closamharc Gaeilge
Úda(i)r: Mac Gabhann, Risteard Cur síos: Cúrsa closamhairc féinteagaisc i nGaeilge do dhaoine fásta. Tá sé dírithe ar thosaitheoirí nó ar dhaoine ar bheagán Gaeilge agus tá sé bunaithe ar chanúint Ghaeltacht Dhún na nGall. Leabhar agus caiséid (caitear iad a cheannach in éineacht). Description: Self-study audio-visual course for adults. Aimed at those with little or no Irish. Donegal dialect. Foilsitheoir: Andersonstown News, Béal Feirste (1975; 4ú heag: 1987) Teideal: Tús Maith Úda(i)r: Mac Gabhann, Risteard Cur síos: Cúrsa féinteagaisc do dhaoine fásta, ina bhfuil fiche aonad ar fad. Tá sé dírithe ar thosaitheoirí nó ar dhaoine ar bheagán Gaeilge agus tá sé bunaithe ar chanúint Ghaeltacht Dhún na nGall. Chomh maith le leabhar an chúrsa, tá trí dhlúthdhiosca i gceist. Description: Self-study course for adults with little or no Irish. Donegal dialect. Book with 3 CDs. Foilsitheoir: Ogmios, 10 Bóthar Dhún an Chreagáin, Doire BT48 OAD
* * *
Teideal: Irish is Fun Úda(i)r: Mac Póilín, Aodán Cur síos: Leabhar greannmhar le ceachtanna grádaithe, cleachtaí, gramadach agus foclóir. Foilsitheoir: Y Lolfa, An Bhreatain Bheag (1987)
* * *
Teideal: Irish is Fun-tastic Úda(i)r: Ó Riain, Seán Cur síos: Tógann an cúrsa seo ar an méid atá sa leabhar Irish is Fun le tuilleadh ceachtanna sa Ghaeilge labhartha. Foilsitheoir: Y Lolfa (1990) Teideal: Lazy Way To Irish Úda(i)r: Ó Riain, Flann Cur síos: Focail, abairtí agus frásaí bunúsacha i nGaeilge. Foilsitheoir: Y Lolfa (1993) Teideal: Cogar Cur síos: Cúrsa i nGaeilge labhartha. Sraith foghlama Gaeilge dírithe ar thosaitheoirí agus orthu siúd ar mhaith leo feabhas a chur ar a gcuid Gaeilge. Tá an cúrsa bunaithe ar shraith comhráite ar deineadh taifeadadh orthu i nGaeltacht Chonamara. 2 leabhar and 4 chaiséad. Description: Course in spoken Irish for beginners or those who want to improve their Irish. Based on conversations recorded in Conamara. 2 books and 4 cassettes. Foilsitheoir: RTÉ/Gael-Linn/ITÉ
* * *
Teideal: Teach Yourself Irish Úda(i)r: Ó Sé, Diarmuid & Sheils, Joseph Cur síos: Cúrsa iomlán do thosaitheoirí agus do dhaoine a d'fhoghlaim Gaeilge ar scoil ach nach raibh mórán deise acu í a labhairt ó shin i leith. Tá comhráite agus eolas faoin bhfoghraíocht le fáil ar chaiséad. Canúint na Mumhan. Description: Complete course for beginners or adults who learnt Irish at school but haven’t had an opportunity to speak it since then. Conversations and phonetics on an accompanying tape. Munster dialect. Foilsitheoir: Hodder & Stoughton (eagrán nua 2002)
* * *
Teideal: Learning Irish Úda(i)r: Ó Siadhail, Mícheál Cur síos: Tá an cúrsa seo bunaithe ar chanúint Chois Fharraige in Iarthar Chontae na Gaillimhe. Tá caiséid ar fáil a mhúineann an córas foghraíochta agus a thacaíonn leis na téacsanna ar fad sa leabhar. Cuirtear cleachtaí ar fáil freisin. Baintear úsáid as an gcóras idirnáisiúnta foghraíochta sa chúrsa seo. Ceithre chaiséad Foilsitheoir: Yale U.P. (1988; eagrán nua: 2006)
* * *
Teideal: Irish for Beginners Úda(i)r: Wilkes, Angela Cur síos: Leabhar taitneamhach ildaite a thugann blaiseadh den Ghaeilge do thosaitheoirí. Dírítear ar ócáidí laethúla agus ar an nGaeilge bhunúsach. Mínítear gramadach nua go soiléir agus tá mórán deiseanna cleachtaidh ann. Comhairleoirí teanga: Séamus Ó Cróinín & Michael Smith. Description: Enjoyable full-colour book that provides a taste of Irish for beginners. Focuses on daily events in basic Irish. Clear explanations of grammar points and numerous opportunities for language practice. Foilsitheoir: Usborne Language Guides (1989)
* * *
Gramadach (Grammar books) Teideal: Teach Yourself Irish Grammar Úda(i)r: Ó Dónaill, Éamonn Cur síos: Leagtar béim sa ghraiméar cuimsitheach seo ar ghramadach úsáideach agus ar úsáid laethúil. Cuirtear na rialacha i láthair go simplí, i dteanga shothuigthe, agus seachnaítear téarmaíocht chasta. Tá cleachtaí le fáil i ngach aonad agus tá freagraí na gcleachtaí sin le fáil ag deireadh an leabhair. Oiriúnach do ghlantosaitheoirí agus do dhaoine ag leibhéil níos airde. Description: Comprehensive grammar with an emphasis on everyday usage. Clear, comprehensible presentation of rules. Exercises with answers. Suitable for complete beginners and other levels. Foilsitheoir: Hodder and Stoughton (2005)
* * *
Teideal: Leabhar Gramadaí Gaeilge Úda(i)r: Mac Congáil, Nollaig Cur síos: Is fada lucht foghlama na Gaeilge ag gearán nach gcuirtear rialacha gramadaí ina láthair ar bhealach díreach sothuigthe. Féachtar leis an scéal sin a leigheas sa leabhar gramadaí seo atá bunaithe ar rialacha gramadaí atá le fáil in Foclóir Gaeilge-Béarla Néill Uí Dhónaill. Foilsitheoir: Cló Iar-Chonnachta (2002) Teideal: Irish Grammar Book Úda(i)r: Mac Congáil, Nollaig Cur síos: Leagan Béarla den leabhar gramadaí thuasluaite. Foilsitheoir: Cló Iar-Chonnachta (2004) Teideal: Cruinnscríobh na Gaeilge Úda(i)r: Mac Murchaidh, Ciarán Cur síos: Gearrchúrsa praiticiúil i ngramadach agus i gcruinnscríobh na Gaeilge atá sa saothar seo. Tá sé dírithe go príomha ar an bhfochéimí Gaeilge ach táthar ag súil go mbainfidh lucht foghlama agus lucht teagaisc araon leas agus tairbhe as. Tá roinnt mhaith cleachtaí ann le cuidiú leis an bhfoghlaimeoir dul i dtaithí ar phríomhstruchtúir agus ar phríomhréimsí gramadaí na Gaeilge. San eagrán nua, athchóirithe, méadaithe seo tá abhar agus cleachtaí breise agus leagan leictreonach den téacs mar áis don úsáideoir. Foilsitheoir: Cois Life (2002; eagrán méadaithe 2004) Teideal: Úrchúrsa Gaeilge Úda(i)r: Ó Baoill, Dónall P. & Ó Rónáin, Conchúr Cur síos: Leabhar gramadaí a dhíríonn isteach ar na fadhbanna is mó a bhíonn ag an bhfoghlaimeoir ar mian leis Gaeilge chruinn a scríobh. Tá roinnt ceachtanna úsáideacha ann. Tá an téacs go hiomlán as Gaeilge. Foilsitheoir: Institiúid Teangeolaíochta Éireann (1980)
* * *
